name: The Gate
when: A drawing moves on its own and stands still while the page's pause is on or for a reader who prefers reduced motion
replaces: The pause helpers under the canvas folder, the reduced-motion query each stage made of its own, and the motion helpers the charts read

examples.name: The Page's Pause
examples.says: Turning the pause on stands every drawing on the page still, this stage's flock included, until it is turned off.
